infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Lumo uses your location to trace the route of a walk and measure how far you went.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Lumo keeps recording your walk while the screen is off, so your route and distance stay accurate when the phone is in your pocket.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Lumo reads your steps, walking and running distance, and active minutes so your movement counts toward your Move goals, badges and challenges automatically.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Lumo reads your step count so a walk can show how many steps it took.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Lumo uses speech recognition to turn your voice into text.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lumo needs the microphone to dictate your journal.
